new_claims.statement: For a nonzero linear bank S=<a,X> of independent cap-one coordinates and 0<p<1, sup_t E|S-t|^{-p} <= 2^p C_p ||a||^{-p}, where C_p is the sharp Chasapis-Konig-Tkocz uniform-comparator constant.

If S is independent of a 2D vector Y, with scalar density cap N, translation-uniform half-Riesz bound H, Y joint density cap M, and K is nonsingular symmetric 3x3 with zero S-pivot, then the quadratic-affine output has continuous density <=3 N^(1/3)(MH)^(2/3)|det K|^(-1/3).

For three disjoint original-coordinate linear banks with coefficient vectors a,b,c and nonsingular zero-pivot 3x3 core K, ||p_Q||_inf <=11.61115845883799 [||a||^2||b||^2||c||^2|det K|]^(-1/3), with continuity in the no-outside theorem.

partner_applied.result: zero-pivot cap-one scalar plus arbitrary 2D joint density theorem
partner_applied.actual_inequality: direct splice gives 12[||a||^2||b||^2||c||^2|det K|]^(-1/3) before JL/CKT sharpening

stress_test: Three flat disjoint m-coordinate banks with core eigenvalues {2,-1,-1}; every nonzero physical coefficient is 1/m and the new bound is 9.215782576064441 uniformly in m.
first_unpaid_implication: QFORM-THREEBANK-CERTIFICATE-OR-PAID-BRANCH-v1: from s3(A)>=1, either route to an existing paid branch or construct disjoint aggregate banks with an exact zero-pivot core and universal lower bound on ||a||^2||b||^2||c||^2|det K|.
source_hypothesis_notes: Juškevičius-Lee is used first for translated small-ball domination by centered uniform comparators.
Chasapis-Konig-Tkocz is used only on those uniform comparators.
Livshyts-Paouris-Pivovarov is used only for product-measure linear marginal density caps.
Banks et al. bilinear density theorem was checked and not extended to arbitrary same-side quadratic remainders.
